reason: I only cook on Sundays, so 3 free questions a day is already way more than I'd ever use. There's nothing for me to pay for. And krapao with a fried egg and kai jeow moo sab are dishes I already make without looking anything up.
objection: Why pay 99 baht a month just for more questions? A free YouTube or TikTok clip already shows me the dish, and the app only has two dishes I already know how to cook.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of dishes I don't already know that are built for Sunday meal prep, cooking a week's worth at once with a shopping list, and the membership being what unlocks them instead of just more questions.
